name: close_lid
scene: sim close_lid (easy_tasks.py CloseLidScorer), hardware 'Tidy up the table' steps 1-2

subtasks.criterion: gripper open and moving toward the open lid's rim; lid fully open
one finger inside the lid, one outside its wall, closed on the rim; lid not yet moving
lid rotating on its hinge toward the case, held or pushed by the gripper

subtasks.text: let go of the closed lid
subtasks.criterion: lid down on the case; fingers opening or just opened
gripper clear of the case, lid closed, arm moving away or home
arm not moving for the whole strip, or doing something none of the entries above describes

stages.name: reach
stages.criterion: finger midpoint within about 5 cm of the lid

stages.name: quarter
stages.criterion: lid rotated at least a quarter of the way closed

stages.name: three_quarters
stages.criterion: lid rotated at least three quarters of the way closed

stages.name: closed
stages.criterion: lid closed on the case and the gripper not touching lid or case
